checks.lead: Yusuf Kironde Lule (10 April 1912 – 21 January 1985) was a Ugandan professor and politician who served as the fourth president of Uganda between 13 April and 20 June 1979, following the overthrow of Idi Amin during the Uganda-Tanzania War. He was also the first black Principal of Makerere University.
